SELECT s.schedule_seq, s.trainno, s.depplacename, s.arrplacename, s.depplandtime, s.arrplandtime, s.booking_open_at, s.first_price, s.standard_price, s.status, ds.nodename AS depStationName, as2.nodename AS arrStationName, t.vehiclekndnm, t.line_category AS lineCategory, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM seat st WHERE st.schedule_seq = s.schedule_seq AND st.status = 'AVAILABLE') AS availableSeats FROM schedule s LEFT JOIN station ds ON s.depplacename = ds.nodeid LEFT JOIN station as2 ON s.arrplacename = as2.nodeid LEFT JOIN train t ON s.trainno = t.trainno

SELECT s.schedule_seq, s.trainno, s.depplacename, s.arrplacename, s.depplandtime, s.arrplandtime, s.booking_open_at, s.first_price, s.standard_price, s.status, ds.nodename AS depStationName, as2.nodename AS arrStationName, t.vehiclekndnm, t.line_category AS lineCategory, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM seat st WHERE st.schedule_seq = s.schedule_seq AND st.status = 'AVAILABLE') AS availableSeats FROM schedule s LEFT JOIN station ds ON s.depplacename = ds.nodeid LEFT JOIN station as2 ON s.arrplacename = as2.nodeid LEFT JOIN train t ON s.trainno = t.trainno WHERE s.schedule_seq = #{scheduleSeq}
